paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Temporal variability of targets included in the literature. We see that there has been a gradual rise towards multi-target datasets.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of targets, either conceptualized or operationalized, over a period of time, from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis represents the proportion of targets, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with an interval of 0.2. Each bar is divided into segments representing different categories of targets, labeled as 0, 1, 2-4, 5-7, and 8+, which are color-coded as dark blue, orange, green, red, and purple, respectively. In 2012 and 2013, the bars are entirely green, indicating a value of approximately 1.0 for the 2-4 category. As the years progress, the bars become increasingly segmented, with the proportion of dark blue (0 targets) decreasing from approximately 0.5 in 2015 to around 0.2-0.3 in 2022, while the proportion of red (5-7 targets) and purple (8+ targets) increases, with the latter appearing from 2018 onwards and reaching a maximum value of around 0.05 in 2022. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar or segment.
